prompt:
Use case: original mascot character design.
Create a NEW cohesive set of FOUR NON-HUMAN mascots for Japanese educational website TOKKATSU広場. The user dislikes human-looking figures and wants familiar, adorable, memorable CHARACTERS that fit the actual homepage. Reference screenshot is the original homepage's four mascots: use it ONLY for the GREEN/VERMILION/BLUE/YELLOW palette, character roles, signature props and simple confident dark outlines. Deliberately REPLACE the human figures with original animal mascots. NO humans or human hair, no humanoid children, no skin-tone human faces. Animals must read immediately as bear/rabbit/bird/puppy, with animal muzzle/beak/paws and natural simplified animal heads.
ONE wide 2:1 landscape character roster, four LARGE full-body mascots side by side on warm cream #FCFBF7 background. Charismatic original hand-designed Japanese mascots, 1.5-1.8 heads tall, a big rounded head flowing into plump simple little body, short paws/feet, huge clear silhouettes, tiny dark oval eyes with brows or charming eyelid expressions, small warm smiling mouths, cheerful cheeks. Family resemblance in face placement and stout body shapes, but clearly different animal silhouettes. Easy to recognize at 80px, clean enough to redraw. Equal visual weight. Premium finished 2D cartoon / polished picture-book character artwork with precise warm dark outline #1C1C1A, solid colored organic shapes, at most ONE discreet flat shadow tone, NO 3D rendering, no gradients, no paper grain, no fur texture, no glossy highlights, no AI anime aesthetic, no complex fingers, no shoes shaped like Mario, no white gloves. Adult teachers should enjoy the design too. Original visual identities; do not replicate any existing mascot franchise.
Order and identities:
1 LEFT 学活くん: a plump forest-green BEAR with two small round ears, warm cream oval muzzle and belly patch, tiny dark round nose, calm kind smile, one raised rounded bear paw in a welcoming wave, other paw holds a small cream note card with two green lines. His familiar simple teddy-like form communicates approachability. NO clothes needed: natural green body and cream belly carry the old green outfit role. Short cream-tipped feet. Small face expression as the reassuring organizer.
2 LEFT CENTER 行人: a warm vermilion-orange RABBIT, two bold soft tall ears, cream muzzle/belly, white sports headband tied beside the base of one ear, tiny dark nose, excited open smile, holding YELLOW triangular flag on short dark pole, lively hopping/marching pose. One ear straight and one gently bent for distinctive silhouette. Short rounded paws, simple elegant anatomy. Athletic energetic but not a human in rabbit costume. All ears and flag inside frame.
3 RIGHT CENTER 児童会ちゃん: round school-blue LITTLE BIRD with tiny yellow beak, bright dark oval eyes, two SMALL CIRCULAR FEATHER TUFTS at left/right sides echoing the original side buns (clearly stylized feather puffs, not human hair), warm cream chest, iconic YELLOW diagonal sash, one rounded wing holds a small handheld microphone, other wing extends welcomingly. Stubby yellow bird feet, cheerful confident face. Bird beak and wings unmistakable, not a humanoid with a bird mask.
4 RIGHT クラブマン: a golden-yellow PUPPY with two soft floppy rounded ears, cream muzzle, small dark button nose, playful wide grin, BLUE simple headband across forehead, short VERMILION-ORANGE cape, WHITE FIVE-POINT STAR outlined dark centered on yellow chest. Both little front paws raised with joy, short hind feet planted apart, small curved puppy tail visible. White star and cape preserve original club identity. No human arms or human torso. Enthusiastic playful maker mascot.
Exact Japanese names beneath each, dark rounded legible Japanese type: 「学活くん」 「行人」 「児童会ちゃん」 「クラブマン」. No subtitles, no frames, no extra labels, no logos, no watermark. Generous whitespace separating each mascot. Use school-blue #3A6EA5, forest green #1F5C3F, vermilion #D2552A, golden #E8C547 with warm cream and warm charcoal; lighter related tones only sparingly. Detailed design quality comes from appealing shape design and expressions, not from texture or decoration. Keep props bold, minimal and readable.
